§6Tiered Upgrades§f

§aTwo paths diverge in a backpack, and you get to pick one§f

Starting at Iron tier, every backpack splits into two specialties: §dStorage§f (more slots) or §dUpgrade§f (more upgrade points for functional modules). Choose carefully, because you can't switch later.

§6Progression§f:
§b• Iron§f: §e36 slots§f (Storage) or §e27 slots§f + §e12 points§f (Upgrade)
§b• Gold§f: §e45 slots§f (Storage) or §e36 slots§f + §e17 points§f (Upgrade)
§b• Diamond§f: §e54 slots§f (Storage) or §e45 slots§f + §e23 points§f (Upgrade)

§6Recipe Pattern§f:
Surround the previous tier's backpack with the tier's material (iron, gold, or diamonds). Put a §bChest§f in the center for Storage path, or a §bBlank Upgrade§f for Upgrade path.

§ePS:§f Upgrade specialty gives you +5 bonus points on top of the base, so a Diamond Upgrade backpack can hold a ridiculous number of functional modules.
